s.note: Steamed pork dumplings with garlic chives and ginger, soy and black vinegar
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with a chopped bunch of garlic chives and 1 tbsp grated ginger. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam 8 minutes. Serve with soy and Chinkiang vinegar, and pour the tea carefully.

s.note: Crisp rolls of cabbage, shiitake, carrot and glass noodles with sweet chilli
s.how: Soak the vermicelli in hot water 5 minutes, drain and snip into short lengths. Stir-fry the wombok, carrot and mushrooms in a splash of the oil until wilted, then add the chopped garlic chives, soy and sesame oil. Toss with the noodles and cool completely. Mix the cornflour with a little water. Roll a spoonful of filling tightly in each wrapper, folding in the sides, and seal with the paste. Heat the oil to 180°C and fry the rolls in batches until golden. Drain and serve with sweet chilli sauce.

s.note: Wok tossed edamame with garlic, chilli and soy, finished with flaky salt
s.how: Steam 500g edamame for 4 minutes. Toss in a hot wok with 2 sliced garlic cloves, chilli flakes and a splash of soy. Finish with plenty of flaky salt and serve in a big bowl.

m.note: Ginger rice porridge, egg and bacon, happy to see you.
m.how: Simmer 200g jasmine rice in 2L chicken stock with sliced ginger for 90 minutes, stirring often, until silky. Fry 4 eggs and 8 rashers bacon. Top each bowl with an egg and bacon smile, spring onion and soy.

m.note: Chicken thighs braised glossy in soy, star anise and rock sugar, bok choy and rice
m.how: Brown the chicken in the oil in a wide pan. Add the ginger, spring onion pieces, star anise and cinnamon, then the soy sauces, Shaoxing, sugar and 250 ml water. Simmer covered for 20 minutes. Uncover and simmer, turning the chicken, until the sauce is glossy and sticky. Cook the rice and steam the halved bok choy for 3 minutes. Serve the chicken and sauce with the rice and bok choy.

w.note: Golden baked pastry filled with sweet lotus seed paste
w.how: Mix 100g golden syrup, 30ml oil and a little alkaline water, then 150g flour, and rest 2 hours. Wrap thin portions around 8 balls of lotus seed paste and press into moulds. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes, egg wash and bake 10 more.

d.n: Family temple iced jasmine lychee tea
d.note: Chilled jasmine green tea sweetened with lychee syrup
d.how: Steep 4 jasmine green tea bags in 1 litre water at 80C for 3 minutes, remove and chill. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Stir 120ml of the syrup and the juice of a lime into the cold tea. Pour over ice in 4 glasses with 3 lychees each and a few mint leaves.
